title: Announcing narration for your docs
summary: Narration lets readers listen to supported documentation pages while Mintlify highlights each sentence and keeps their place on screen.
body_markdown:
Narration is now available to Mintlify customers on Pro plans and above. Once enabled, readers can listen to supported documentation pages while Mintlify highlights each sentence and keeps their place on screen.


Previously, adding audio to documentation meant recording, hosting, and updating files by hand. Every content change created more work, while generic text-to-speech tools read code, tables, and interface elements as noise. Now every supported page can have an audio version without a separate production workflow.


## How narration works


A **Listen to this page** player appears at the top of each supported page. Press play and narration begins streaming within seconds.


Readers can pause, track progress, and adjust playback speed from 0.5× to 2×. As each sentence is spoken, Mintlify highlights it and automatically scrolls the page to keep it in view. If the reader scrolls elsewhere, automatic scrolling stops while the audio continues.


Opening another page stops the current narration. Playback speed is remembered for the rest of the session.


We built Narration using ElevenLabs Eleven Turbo v2.5 model. Narration works across languages. For sites with languages configured in` docs.json` navigation, Mintlify sends the page's locale to ElevenLabs as the` language_code` . For sites without configured languages, the model auto-detects the language from the page text.


See how the player works and watch Narration in action on the[Mintlify docs](https://www.mintlify.com/docs) .


## Built for technical content


Narration understands the structure of documentation. It reads the title, description, and body in order while announcing elements such as steps, tabs, callouts, and accordions with short spoken cues.


Code blocks, tables, media, API fields, and other content that doesn’t translate well to audio are skipped. Tabs switch and collapsed sections open when they contain content being read.


This makes Narration useful for readers following a guide from another window, working hands-on in a terminal, browsing from a phone, or benefiting from an alternative to reading dense pages on screen.


## Pricing


Narration uses AI credits. It costs **50 AI credits** the first time someone listens to a new or updated page.


Replays of the same page version are free. If narration fails to generate, you aren’t charged.


## Get started


1. Open your project in the[Mintlify dashboard](https://app.mintlify.com/settings/deployment/general) .
2. Go to **Settings → General → Narration** .
3. Enable **Page narration** . Mintlify automatically rebuilds your site to apply the change.
